references.label: THUNDER MAN lanes
references.description: Five top and inlane switches spelling T-H, U-N, D-E, R-M, and A-N.

references.label: Multiplier tunnel
references.description: Lane that raises the star value and advances Bonus X after the value is maxed.

references.label: Yellow three-drop bank
references.description: Bank that advances Thunder Special when cleared.

references.label: Thunder Special target
references.description: Yellow target that collects the lit Thunder Special award.

references.label: Add Man hole
references.description: Hole that scores 100,000 and advances Man Special.

references.label: Man Special target
references.description: Red target that collects the lit Man Special award.

references.label: Rotary target
references.description: Spinning target whose value depends on hit speed.
